description.en: The name of the custom job.
Specifies whether to return an encrypted YAML string.
The ID of the environment instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms describe-env-custom-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --environment-id env-xxxxxx --custom-job-name customJob1 --encrypt-yaml true --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms DescribeEnvCustomJob --region cn-hangzhou --EncryptYaml true --EnvironmentId 'env-xxxxxx' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --CustomJobName customJob1
